Who we are

Built Around Opportunity

United Assets Investments brings together a diversified range of business activities designed to connect commercial opportunities across regional and international markets. The group is structured so that a client with a mixed requirement — materials, equipment, freight and the paperwork around them — can deal with one commercial party rather than five.

Our approach combines strategic sourcing, trading, logistics coordination, industrial supply and business development. Oman is our base and our advantage: a trading position on the Arabian Sea with direct routes to the Gulf, East Africa and South Asia.

Industries

Where our supply lands

All industries →
Construction → Material packages and equipment sequenced to build programmes. Infrastructure → Supply for roads, utilities and public works programmes. Manufacturing → Process inputs, spares and equipment for operating plants. Engineering → Specification-led sourcing against drawings and standards. Logistics → Handling equipment, warehouse fit-out and movement coordination. Hospitality → Guest room, housekeeping and food service supply programmes. Energy → Equipment and consumable supply for energy operations. Industrial Projects → Consolidated supply for plant construction and expansion.

Why United Assets?

Six reasons clients give when they come back — stated plainly, without the superlatives.

Diversified

Eight business sectors under one commercial platform, so a mixed requirement does not become a procurement exercise across five vendors.

Strategic

Focused on sourcing and commercial opportunity rather than holding stock for its own sake.

Connected

Built around working relationships between suppliers, customers and markets.

Flexible

Scope is shaped to the requirement — a single enquiry or a recurring supply programme.

International

Designed around cross-border trade: documentation, freight and clearance as part of the offer.

Partnership Driven

Measured on repeat business, not on the first transaction.
